Canonical MIT/MPL generator hashes remain distinct from mapped actual files; both Windows mappings intentionally differ from the canonical generator text.
Windows linked native-runtime materials remain outside this candidate. Rust precompiled-standard-library materials have a separate retained-material review and are not among these crate bindings.
